defectsFound.summary: A caller chose the identity their rate limit was counted against.
defectsFound.mechanism: clientIp read x-forwarded-for and took .split(',')[0] -- the leftmost entry, which is whatever the client wrote. That value keyed the agent relay's per-minute limit and the public intake's per-hour cap. Rotating the header made eight public intake submissions succeed against a cap of three (202 for every one), and each accepted submission creates a lead and queues research work.
defectsFound.fix: TRUST_PROXY_HOPS declares how many proxies may be believed, defaulting to 0: the header is ignored and the socket address answers. With N hops the trustworthy address is the Nth from the right, because each proxy appends the address it received the connection from -- so prepended entries shift the chain rightward and cannot move the answer. Fails closed: behind an undeclared proxy all callers share one identity and the limit is too strict.
defectsFound.provenBy: tests/client-identity-trust.test.mjs, four tests, a child process per configuration because config is read once at import
